characters.title: Chada Boi
characters.description: Chada Boi collects discarded sounds for the Crypto Stoned Boys. His recording of two bells becomes evidence at the Ninth Berth.

characters.title: Nobby
characters.description: Nobby is the Hard Fork Rocker who helps keep the Ninth Berth running and asks who pays for a better way of doing things.

characters.title: Jimmy Rugpull
characters.description: Jimmy Rugpull represents the Rugpull Miners on the Waterfront, where he tries to make sure a failed deal still leaves workers paid.

characters.title: Danny Rankz
characters.description: Danny Rankz of the Blockchain Furies hears the Ninth Berth’s claims and follows the evidence from unpaid wages to a failing gauge.

characters.title: Teddy Boi Jones
characters.description: Teddy Boi Jones is a Blockstars broadcaster who puts voices from the Ninth Berth on air and argues for the people behind the show.

characters.title: Jack the Bull
characters.description: Jack the Bull brings the All City Bulls’ competitive drive to the Ninth Berth, where a timed spectacle becomes a real relief run.

characters.title: Nine Toes Joe
characters.description: Nine Toes Joe is a Nomad Bears guide who keeps an independent way home open for the crews of Lumina’s Waterfront.

lore.title: The Ninth Berth
lore.description: The Ninth Berth is a working dock on Lumina’s Waterfront. Meet nine faction representatives whose lives cross on the night of the double tide.
